description: Get a quote for adding liquidity to a position. Estimates swap routes (Jupiter), price impact, output amounts, and immediate resale gap. Verifies NFT ownership, pool state, and balance. Read-only. Quotes expire quickly (configured TTL). Failure modes: insufficient balance, high price impact (>5%), resale floor breach, quote expiration, pool state changes.

amount.description: Amount in token units (e.g. '1.5' for 1.5 SOL)

inputKind.description: Asset kind: 'native' for SOL, 'token' for SPL tokens

inputMint.description: Input asset mint address (from list_positions assets)

resaleFloorBps.description: Minimum resale ratio in basis points (9500-10000, default 9900 = 1% max loss). Conservative immediate-resale protection.

slippageToleranceBps.description: Add-liquidity price tolerance in basis points (0-500, multiple of 10, default 100 = 1%). Liquidity is sized so the pool price may drift this much before execution; the unused reserve stays in the wallet. Jupiter swap slippage stays fixed at 0.5%.

name: quote_add_liquidity
